title.suggested: Tom Allen's Concert Hall at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and only the best talent engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, January 28, 1893

facts.fact: Allen advertised his concert hall at 619 Market Street as "retired champion pugilist of the world," with a free concert every evening

notes: Current title is vague and does not name Allen.
